doc: The Writ at the Toll Gate (slug toll-gate-writ) — slot 2 of the expert-everyday-2 batch (THR-1679).
systems READY, package critic PACKAGE PASS).
plotHook taken: hook.mad_artificer, drifted to an old seal-cutter selling cheap false writs.
Shape: Personality Fork on `revelation_discretion`. Seeker (positive, also fallback) traces the
maker (eye 0.64); Sentinel (negative) vouches and holds the toll-master's trust (heart 0.62).
Consequence hand: knowledge (intelligence) + movement (agent_relocation) on both arms; favor_creation
on the Sentinel win. Measurement note: the fork step has no top-level difficulty, so roll-spread

template.name: The Writ at the Toll Gate

openings.urban: {actor} reaches the toll gate of {location} at dawn, behind a travelling family.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
The family carries a writ of passage that frees them of the toll. The toll-master, {cast:tollmaster}, doubts it and asks {actor}, who has a trained eye, to judge it. The writ is forged, and forged well. Under the town's toll charter, whoever approves a writ answers for it.

Naming it false sends the family to the town's court. Approving it puts {actor}'s name on a forgery.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {actor} found the fault at once. The seal is a copy of the town's own toll seal, and a good one.
steps.successAfterimage: {actor} found the fault. The seal is a copy of the town's own toll seal.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: {actor} found the fault, but kept the family and the toll-master waiting half the morning.
steps.failureAfterimage: {actor} is sure the writ is wrong, but cannot point to the fault.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: {actor} misread the seal in front of the whole gate, and {cast:tollmaster} saw it.

nudges.name: Light The Page
nudges.effectLine: Throw the sun full across the writ, so every stroke of ink and wax shows. A fault seen this plainly is hard to keep quiet.

bandProse.success: The sun fell full across the writ, and the wax showed its seam.
bandProse.near_miss: The sun lit the ink, but a cloud crossed before it reached the seal.
bandProse.failure: The sun lit every stroke, and every stroke looked right.

nudges.name: Cool Their Scorn
nudges.effectLine: Ease any contempt for the family, so they read the writ slowly and miss no fault. Without contempt, they are slower to condemn.

bandProse.critical_success: {actor} read the writ without haste or scorn, and saw every fault in it.
bandProse.success_at_cost: {actor} read slowly and without scorn, and the carters behind the family began to shout.
bandProse.failure: {actor} read the writ without scorn, and wanted it to be good.
bandProse.critical_failure: {actor} read the writ as a friend would, and saw only what a friend would see.

positive.narrativeTemplate: {actor} names the writ false, and the family is held at the gate for the town's court. The court wants the maker as well. {cast:traveller}, who leads the family, will not say where the writ was bought. {actor} goes into the town to find who cut the seal.
positive.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {actor} found the maker at the bench: an old seal-cutter who has copied the toll seal for years, and sells the writs cheap to families who cannot pay the toll.
positive.successAfterimage: {actor} found the maker: an old seal-cutter who has copied the toll seal for years.
positive.successAtCostAfterimage: {actor} found the old seal-cutter by nightfall, after asking at every shop on the market.
positive.failureAfterimage: {actor} searched the town all day, and no one would say who cut the seal.
positive.criticalFailureAfterimage: The seal-cutter heard that a writ had been stopped, and was gone before {actor} found the shop.

effects.label: Who copies the toll seal
effects.detail: An old seal-cutter in the town has copied the toll seal for years and sells false writs cheap to families who cannot pay the toll.

nudges.name: Guide Their Steps
nudges.effectLine: Lead them down the right lane first, so they reach the maker's door before word of the held family does.

bandProse.success: {actor} took the right lane first and came straight to the seal-cutter's door.
bandProse.near_miss: {actor} took the right lane, and found the shop shut until evening.
bandProse.failure: {actor} took the right lane first, and walked past the shop without knowing it.

nudges.name: Twist A Steady Hand
nudges.effectLine: Put a tremor in the maker's fingers at the bench, so a botched seal lies there for them to find.

bandProse.critical_success: The seal-cutter botched a fresh copy of the seal, and {actor} found it on the bench.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The seal-cutter botched a fresh seal and threw it in the fire before {actor} arrived.
bandProse.failure: The seal-cutter's hand shook, and no one saw it but the seal-cutter.
bandProse.critical_failure: The seal-cutter's hand shook, and the seal-cutter took it as a warning.

negative.narrativeTemplate: {actor} vouches for the family, and they go through the gate without paying the toll. Under the charter, the writ is now {actor}'s to answer for. In front of the waiting carters, {cast:tollmaster} asks why {actor} frowned over a sound seal.
negative.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {cast:tollmaster} took {actor}'s word without a second question.
negative.successAfterimage: {cast:tollmaster} took {actor}'s word and let the question drop.
negative.successAtCostAfterimage: {cast:tollmaster} took {actor}'s word, but only after an hour of hard questions.
negative.failureAfterimage: {cast:tollmaster} did not believe {actor}, and sent a guard after the family.
negative.criticalFailureAfterimage: {cast:tollmaster} sent a guard after the family before {actor} had finished speaking.

effects.context: Vouched for the family at the toll gate

effects.label: Who copies the toll seal
effects.detail: The family bought the writ from an old seal-cutter in the town, who sells copies of the toll seal to travellers who cannot pay.

nudges.name: Kindle Goodwill
nudges.effectLine: Warm the toll-master toward them, so the hardest questions are asked kindly.

bandProse.success: {cast:tollmaster} warmed to {actor}, and asked the last question kindly.
bandProse.near_miss: {cast:tollmaster} warmed to {actor}, but asked every question anyway.
bandProse.failure: {cast:tollmaster} warmed to {actor}, and still did not believe them.

nudges.name: Turn Away Eyes
nudges.effectLine: Draw the waiting carters' attention elsewhere, so the toll-master can let it go without an audience.

bandProse.critical_success: The carters turned to watch a loose cart horse, and no one heard {cast:tollmaster} let it go.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The carters looked away, but a guard at the gate heard every word.
bandProse.failure: The carters looked away, and {cast:tollmaster} asked the questions anyway.
bandProse.critical_failure: The carters looked away, then looked back as {cast:tollmaster} raised the alarm.

template.description: A two-step Eye test for an expert at a town gate: read a travelling family's writ of passage and find it a good forgery, then decide its cost. The mortal either names it false and hunts the seal-cutter who made it (a bigger standing gain and a summons), or vouches for the family and answers for the writ under the town's charter (a favour owed and the maker's name secondhand). A win leaves the maker's name known and the mortal on the road; a loss costs standing in the town.
